column1: # The GRTeclyn source each packed run was launched from, one row per commit, tab-separated: the commit
# (metadata.json git_commit, first 8 hex digits) and the runs launched from it. Every v1 run used the
# example's own build, Examples/RadialRecipe/main3d.gnu.MPI.CUDA.ex, rebuilt in place, so no binary hash
# was recorded; the revision's frozen builds live in runs/bondi/bin/ and get rows here when their runs are
# packed. '-' marks a run with no metadata.json (driven straight from the executable).
